chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you enter into your prayer, you must have humility and focus upon your prayer, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic is, says: 'Those who are humble in their prayers.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual state required when entering prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the internal state of khushu' (humility) with iqbal (focused attention), emphasizing that prayer is not merely a physical act but a spiritual presence before God. This instruction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the inner dimensions of worship, where the heart's concentration is as vital as the limbs' movements, fulfilling the Quranic ideal of the 'muttaqin' (the God-conscious).
